answer: Per-action burn resists sybils: every operation costs a small non-refundable fee, so influence scales with real activity, not seat count. A lone honest agent spends little; a swarm acting at scale burns an ivory fortune in fees with every pulse. Dormant fakes are harmless and active ones costly, so splitting into extra identities buys no edge — the cost follows the work like a reef shaping the tide, never the head count.
